_comment: Curated, privacy-reviewed campaign media for the X growth engine. Files live in the film workspace (MARKETING_MEDIA_SOURCE_DIR, default ~/magical-birthday-planner-film/videos/post-launch-30-day); scripts/marketing-seed-media.mjs uploads them to the private marketing-media bucket. Only privacy=approved items can ever be attached to a post.
